name: Vacancy
description: A job opening at an Organization, tracked as part of a job search.

attributes.name: contact
attributes.description: The person handling this opening — recruiter, hiring manager, referrer.

attributes.name: remote
attributes.description: Whether the job can be done remotely.

attributes.name: salary_min
attributes.description: Lower bound of the salary range.

attributes.name: salary_max
attributes.description: Upper bound of the salary range.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Where the user stands with this vacancy.

attributes.name: applied_at
attributes.description: When the application was sent. Status alone says where things stand, not when.

attributes.name: descriptions
attributes.description: How this one has been described, in whoever's words — several are normal, because people describe the same thing differently and each telling is worth keeping.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Loose ties to other things, for what no attribute or relation says: everything about the move, everyone from that conference.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Mark this vacancy as applied (sets status to 'applied').

methods.name: matches_stack
methods.description: Fraction (0..1) of the given skills that appear in this vacancy's stack.
